title: JKLab
description: JKLab develops BerEditor, CertMan, and CryptokiMan for analysis of PKI technology.

items.title: Basic Encoding Rule
items.content_html: Learn ASN.1 BER encoding with TLV, tags, lengths, data types, OIDs, and practical hexadecimal examples.

items.title: Download
items.content_html: Download BerEditor for Windows, macOS, or Linux to view and edit ASN.1 BER/DER data and KMIP TTLV messages.

items.title: ASN.1 BER vs DER
items.content_html: Compare ASN.1 BER and DER encoding rules with hexadecimal examples, including lengths, Boolean values, strings, certificates, and signatures.

items.title: Home
items.content_html: Explore JKLab’s PKI software and guides, including BerEditor, CertMan, CryptokiMan, digital certificates, and public key infrastructure.

items.title: About me
items.content_html: Meet JayKim, the developer of JKLab’s PKI and cryptography tools, and find contact and support information.

items.title: Tools
items.content_html: Explore JKLab tools for ASN.1 data, X.509 certificates, and PKCS#11 hardware security modules.

items.title: Release
items.content_html: Review BerEditor release notes, feature updates, and fixes for the ASN.1 BER/DER and KMIP tool.

items.title: JKLab Blog
items.content_html: Read updates and articles from JKLab on PKI, cryptography, and software tools.

items.title: Download
items.content_html: Download CertMan for Windows, macOS, or Linux to manage X.509 certificates, key pairs, CSRs, and CRLs.

items.title: Release
items.content_html: Review CertMan release notes, feature updates, and fixes for the X.509 certificate and CRL manager.

items.title: Download
items.content_html: Download CryptokiMan for Windows, macOS, or Linux to manage and test PKCS#11 Cryptoki modules.

items.title: Release
items.content_html: Review CryptokiMan release notes, feature updates, and fixes for the PKCS#11 Cryptoki manager.

items.title: PKI Concept
items.content_html: Learn the basics of public key infrastructure, including certificate authorities, registration authorities, certificates, and revocation.

items.title: Digital Signatures and Certificates
items.content_html: Understand digital signatures, certificates, certificate authorities, and PKI through a plain-language analogy.

items.title: PrivateKey, PublicKey, Certificate
items.content_html: Learn how private keys, public keys, and certificates work together to create and verify digital signatures.

items.title: Applying the license
items.content_html: Learn how to request and apply a free 60-day license for BerEditor, CertMan, and CryptokiMan.
